CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.assert_publication(row_tenant text, row_collection text, row_document text, prior_active text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    owner_row record;
    document_row record;
    intent_row record;
    prepared record;
BEGIN
    SELECT instance_id,owner_token,backend_epoch,intent_id INTO owner_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners
    WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication owner absent' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
    PERFORM cragkit_qdrant.lock_publication_owner(row_tenant,row_collection,row_document,
        owner_row.instance_id,owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch,false);
    PERFORM 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant
        AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document FOR UPDATE;
    -- Fresh reads follow all three locks; the first owner lookup only locates keys.
    SELECT instance_id,owner_token,backend_epoch,intent_id INTO owner_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners
    WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document;
    SELECT active_generation_id,authorization_revision,mutation_epoch,tombstoned INTO document_row
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document;
    SELECT intent_id,action,state,manifest_sha256,expected_active_generation_id,expected_authorization_revision,
        expected_mutation_epoch,generation_id,authority_committed,replica_complete,instance_id INTO intent_row
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.publication_intents WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant AND collection = row_collection
        AND document_id = row_document AND intent_id = owner_row.intent_id;
    -- Exactly one original preparation anchors both alternatives. The attestation
    -- key is the current owner/epoch, never an ordered/latest row selection.
    SELECT selected.owner_token,selected.backend_epoch,selected.authorization_revision,
        selected.mutation_epoch,selected.manifest_sha256,selected.instance_id INTO prepared
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.preparations AS original
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT original.owner_token,original.backend_epoch,original.authorization_revision,
            original.mutation_epoch,original.manifest_sha256,original.instance_id
        WHERE ROW(original.owner_token,original.backend_epoch,original.instance_id,original.manifest_sha256,
            original.authorization_revision,original.mutation_epoch)
            IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch,owner_row.instance_id,
                intent_row.manifest_sha256,document_row.authorization_revision,document_row.mutation_epoch)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT attestation.owner_token,attestation.backend_epoch,attestation.authorization_revision,
            attestation.mutation_epoch,attestation.manifest_sha256,attestation.instance_id
        FROM cragkit_qdrant.preparation_attestations AS attestation
        WHERE attestation.tenant_id = row_tenant AND attestation.collection = row_collection
            AND attestation.document_id = row_document AND attestation.intent_id = owner_row.intent_id
            AND attestation.backend_epoch = owner_row.backend_epoch AND attestation.owner_token = owner_row.owner_token
            AND attestation.backend_epoch > original.backend_epoch
            AND attestation.expected_active_generation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM intent_row.expected_active_generation_id
            AND ROW(attestation.instance_id,attestation.manifest_sha256,attestation.authorization_revision,attestation.mutation_epoch)
                IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(original.instance_id,original.manifest_sha256,original.authorization_revision,original.mutation_epoch)
    ) AS selected
    WHERE original.tenant_id = row_tenant AND original.collection = row_collection
        AND original.document_id = row_document AND original.intent_id = owner_row.intent_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR intent_row.action <> 'stage' OR intent_row.state <> 'published'
        OR NOT intent_row.authority_committed OR NOT intent_row.replica_complete OR document_row.tombstoned
        OR intent_row.expected_active_generation_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior_active
        OR intent_row.generation_id IS DISTINCT FROM document_row.active_generation_id
        OR owner_row.intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.writer_intent_id',true)
        OR owner_row.owner_token::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.writer_owner_token',true)
        OR ROW(prepared.owner_token,prepared.backend_epoch,prepared.instance_id,prepared.manifest_sha256,
            prepared.authorization_revision,prepared.mutation_epoch)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch,owner_row.instance_id,
                intent_row.manifest_sha256,document_row.authorization_revision,document_row.mutation_epoch)
        OR ROW(intent_row.expected_authorization_revision,intent_row.expected_mutation_epoch)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(document_row.authorization_revision,document_row.mutation_epoch)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.dispatch_journal WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant
            AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document AND state <> 'settled')
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.generations WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant
            AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document
            AND generation_id = intent_row.generation_id AND published AND ever_published)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.generations WHERE tenant_id = row_tenant
            AND collection = row_collection AND document_id = row_document
            AND generation_id <> intent_row.generation_id AND published) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'atomic publication facts disagree' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.generations AS generation
        WHERE generation.tenant_id = row_tenant AND generation.collection = row_collection
            AND generation.document_id = row_document AND generation.generation_id = intent_row.generation_id
            AND (generation.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.members AS member
                WHERE member.tenant_id = row_tenant AND member.collection = row_collection
                    AND member.document_id = row_document AND member.generation_id = intent_row.generation_id)
                OR generation.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.point_claims AS claim
                    WHERE claim.tenant_id = row_tenant AND claim.collection = row_collection
                        AND claim.document_id = row_document AND claim.generation_id = intent_row.generation_id)
                OR generation.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.vector_replays AS replay
                    WHERE replay.tenant_id = row_tenant AND replay.collection = row_collection
                        AND replay.document_id = row_document AND replay.generation_id = intent_row.generation_id))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication membership changed after preparation' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.bound_stage(row_tenant text, row_collection text, row_document text, row_revision text, row_generation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT cragkit_qdrant.writer_scope(row_tenant, row_collection, row_document) AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.publication_intents AS intent
        WHERE intent.tenant_id = row_tenant AND intent.collection = row_collection
            AND intent.document_id = row_document
            AND intent.intent_id = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.writer_intent_id', true)
            AND intent.instance_id = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.backend_instance_id', true)
            AND intent.action = 'stage' AND intent.revision_id = row_revision
            AND (row_generation IS NULL OR intent.generation_id = row_generation))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.check_dispatch_commit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.dispatch_points WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id
        AND intent_id = NEW.intent_id AND dispatch_id = NEW.dispatch_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispatch lacks claimed point set' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

 physical_collection,collection_incarnation,owner_token,purge_payload_sha256,tombstone_payload_sha256,authorization_revision,mutation_epoch,inventory_sha256,policy_id,absence_sha256,erasure_sha256)
 VALUES(p_tenant_id,p_collection,p_document_id,p_purge_intent_id,p_instance_id,p_backend_namespace,p_storage_identity,p_supervisor_id,p_backend_epoch,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.guard_dispatch_point()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    journal record;
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable dispatch point' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
    SELECT instance_id,owner_token,backend_epoch,recovery,state,created_xid INTO journal
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.dispatch_journal WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection
        AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND intent_id = NEW.intent_id AND dispatch_id = NEW.dispatch_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR journal.state <> 'reserved' OR journal.created_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.point_claims WHERE backend_namespace = NEW.backend_namespace
            AND physical_collection = NEW.physical_collection AND collection_incarnation = NEW.collection_incarnation
            AND point_id = NEW.point_id AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection
            AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND instance_id = journal.instance_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispatch point owner mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.dispatch_points WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND intent_id = NEW.intent_id
        AND dispatch_id = NEW.dispatch_id) >= 8 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispatch point bound exceeded' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.guard_generation_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['published','ever_published'])
        IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['published','ever_published'])
        OR (OLD.ever_published AND NOT NEW.ever_published) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable generation identity or publication history' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.guard_managed_body_erasure()

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

BEGIN
 columns:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME WHEN 'document_revisions' THEN ARRAY['canonical_utf8','content_erased']

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.guard_point_claim()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    member_row record;
BEGIN
    IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'managed writes require read committed' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable physical claim' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
    SELECT member.point_id, member.source_sha256, member.text_sha256, member.start_byte, member.end_byte,
        generation.backend_namespace,generation.physical_collection,generation.collection_incarnation,
        generation.dense_profile,generation.sparse_profile INTO member_row
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.members AS member JOIN cragkit_qdrant.generations AS generation
        USING (tenant_id,collection,document_id,revision_id,generation_id)
    WHERE member.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND member.collection = NEW.collection
        AND member.document_id = NEW.document_id AND member.revision_id = NEW.revision_id
        AND member.generation_id = NEW.generation_id AND member.chunk_id = NEW.chunk_id FOR KEY SHARE OF member,generation;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(NEW.point_id,NEW.source_sha256,NEW.text_sha256,NEW.start_byte,NEW.end_byte,
        NEW.backend_namespace,NEW.physical_collection,NEW.collection_incarnation,NEW.dense_profile,NEW.sparse_profile)
        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(member_row.point_id,member_row.source_sha256,member_row.text_sha256,
        member_row.start_byte,member_row.end_byte,member_row.backend_namespace,member_row.physical_collection,
        member_row.collection_incarnation,member_row.dense_profile,member_row.sparse_profile)
        OR NOT cragkit_qdrant.bound_stage(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.collection,NEW.document_id,NEW.revision_id,NEW.generation_id)
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.backend_instances WHERE instance_id = NEW.instance_id
            AND backend_namespace = NEW.backend_namespace) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical claim owner mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.guard_preparation_attestation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    owner_row record;
    document_row record;
    intent_row record;
    original record;
    generation_row record;
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable preparation attestation' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    PERFORM cragkit_qdrant.lock_publication_owner(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.collection,NEW.document_id,
        NEW.instance_id,NEW.owner_token,NEW.backend_epoch,false);
    -- Extend the shared backend -> owner lock order with the document lock.
    -- Every authoritative value below is reread after all lock waits.
    PERFORM 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'attestation document absent' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT instance_id,owner_token,backend_epoch,intent_id INTO owner_row
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id;
    SELECT active_generation_id,authorization_revision,mutation_epoch,tombstoned INTO document_row
    FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id;
    SELECT action,state,manifest_sha256,expected_active_generation_id,expected_authorization_revision,
        expected_mutation_epoch,revision_id,generation_id,instance_id
    INTO intent_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.publication_intents WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND intent_id = NEW.intent_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'attestation intent absent' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT instance_id,owner_token,backend_epoch,authorization_revision,mutation_epoch,manifest_sha256
    INTO original FROM cragkit_qdrant.preparations WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND intent_id = NEW.intent_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR cragkit_qdrant.writer_scope(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.collection,NEW.document_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
        OR NEW.intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.writer_intent_id',true)
        OR NEW.instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.backend_instance_id',true)
        OR NEW.owner_token::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.writer_owner_token',true)
        OR ROW(owner_row.instance_id,owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch,owner_row.intent_id)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.instance_id,NEW.owner_token,NEW.backend_epoch,NEW.intent_id)
        OR intent_row.action <> 'stage' OR intent_row.state <> 'prepared'
        OR document_row.tombstoned OR NEW.backend_epoch <= original.backend_epoch
        OR ROW(original.instance_id,original.manifest_sha256,original.authorization_revision,original.mutation_epoch)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.instance_id,NEW.manifest_sha256,NEW.authorization_revision,NEW.mutation_epoch)
        OR ROW(intent_row.instance_id,intent_row.manifest_sha256,intent_row.expected_authorization_revision,
            intent_row.expected_mutation_epoch,intent_row.expected_active_generation_id)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.instance_id,NEW.manifest_sha256,NEW.authorization_revision,
                NEW.mutation_epoch,NEW.expected_active_generation_id)
        OR ROW(document_row.active_generation_id,document_row.authorization_revision,document_row.mutation_epoch)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.expected_active_generation_id,NEW.authorization_revision,NEW.mutation_epoch)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.dispatch_journal WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
            AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id AND state <> 'settled') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'attestation intent or current fence mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT expected_member_count,backend_namespace,physical_collection,collection_incarnation,
        dense_profile,sparse_profile INTO generation_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.generations
    WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id
        AND revision_id = intent_row.revision_id AND generation_id = intent_row.generation_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR generation_row.expected_member_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        OR generation_row.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.members
            WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id
                AND revision_id = intent_row.revision_id AND generation_id = intent_row.generation_id)
        OR generation_row.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.point_claims
            WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id
                AND revision_id = intent_row.revision_id AND generation_id = intent_row.generation_id)
        OR generation_row.expected_member_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM cragkit_qdrant.vector_replays
            WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND collection = NEW.collection AND document_id = NEW.document_id
                AND revision_id = intent_row.revision_id AND generation_id = intent_row.generation_id)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.members AS member
            LEFT JOIN cragkit_qdrant.point_claims AS claim
                USING (tenant_id,collection,document_id,revision_id,generation_id,chunk_id)
            LEFT JOIN cragkit_qdrant.vector_replays AS replay
                ON replay.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND replay.collection = member.collection
                AND replay.document_id = member.document_id AND replay.revision_id = member.revision_id
                AND replay.generation_id = member.generation_id AND replay.chunk_id = member.chunk_id
            WHERE member.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND member.collection = NEW.collection
                AND member.document_id = NEW.document_id AND member.revision_id = intent_row.revision_id
                AND member.generation_id = intent_row.generation_id
                AND (claim.point_id IS NULL OR replay.point_id IS NULL
                    OR ROW(claim.instance_id,claim.point_id,claim.source_sha256,claim.text_sha256,
                        claim.start_byte,claim.end_byte,claim.backend_namespace,claim.physical_collection,
                        claim.collection_incarnation,claim.dense_profile,claim.sparse_profile)
                        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.instance_id,member.point_id,member.source_sha256,
                            member.text_sha256,member.start_byte,member.end_byte,generation_row.backend_namespace,
                            generation_row.physical_collection,generation_row.collection_incarnation,
                            generation_row.dense_profile,generation_row.sparse_profile)
                    OR ROW(replay.point_id,replay.backend_namespace,replay.physical_collection,replay.collection_incarnation)
                        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(member.point_id,generation_row.backend_namespace,
                            generation_row.physical_collection,generation_row.collection_incarnation))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'incomplete attestation membership' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.lock_current_security(p_instance_id text, p_backend_namespace text, p_storage_identity text, p_supervisor_id text, p_recovery_id text, p_backend_epoch bigint, p_tenant_id text, p_collection text, p_document_id text, p_owner_intent_id text, p_owner_token uuid, p_security_intent_id text, p_security_payload_sha256 text, p_active_generation_id text, p_authorization_revision text, p_mutation_epoch bigint, p_principal_ids text[], p_grant_ids text[], p_language text, p_kind text, p_tag text, p_tombstoned boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    caller_id oid;
    guard_id oid;
    supervisor_role_id oid;
    operator_id oid;
    function_id oid;
    identity_value text;
    acl_value text[];
    backend_row record;
    owner_row record;
    document_row record;
    security_row record;
BEGIN
    SELECT oid INTO caller_id FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
    SELECT oid INTO guard_id FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname='cragkit_qdrant_security_guard';
    SELECT oid INTO supervisor_role_id FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname='cragkit_qdrant_supervisor';
    SELECT nspowner INTO operator_id FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname='cragkit_qdrant';
    function_id:=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.lock_current_security(text,text,text,text,text,bigint,text,text,text,text,uuid,text,text,text,text,bigint,text[],text[],text,text,text,boolean)');

    IF pg_catalog.current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'none'
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=caller_id AND rolcanlogin
           AND NOT(rolsuper OR rolbypassrls OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolreplication))
       OR NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,supervisor_role_id,'USAGE')
       OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,'cragkit_qdrant_writer','MEMBER')
       OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,guard_id,'MEMBER')
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,r.oid,'MEMBER')
           AND (r.rolsuper OR r.rolbypassrls OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolcreatedb OR r.rolreplication
                OR r.rolname IN ('pg_read_all_data','pg_write_all_data','pg_read_server_files','pg_write_server_files','pg_execute_server_program')))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_database d WHERE pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,d.datdba,'MEMBER'))
       OR NOT pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(caller_id,'cragkit_qdrant','USAGE')
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant'
           AND (pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,n.nspowner,'MEMBER') OR pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(caller_id,n.oid,'CREATE')))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,c.relowner,'MEMBER'))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,p.proowner,'MEMBER'))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(caller_id,t.typowner,'MEMBER'))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
          CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE','REFERENCES','TRIGGER']) privilege
          WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r'
          AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(caller_id,c.oid,privilege) IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
            WHEN privilege='SELECT' THEN c.relname IN ('schema_migrations','backend_instances','document_owners','point_claims','dispatch_points','preparations')
            WHEN privilege='INSERT' THEN c.relname IN ('backend_instances','dispatch_journal','dispatch_points')
            WHEN privilege='UPDATE' THEN c.relname='backend_instances' ELSE false END)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid
          JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
          CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','REFERENCES']) privilege
          WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
          AND pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(caller_id,c.oid,a.attnum,privilege) IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
            WHEN privilege='SELECT' THEN c.relname IN ('schema_migrations','backend_instances','document_owners','point_claims','dispatch_points','preparations')
              OR (c.relname='documents' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','content_unavailable'))
              OR (c.relname='publication_intents' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','intent_id','instance_id','action','payload_sha256','manifest_sha256','revision_id','generation_id','expected_active_generation_id','expected_authorization_revision','expected_mutation_epoch','state','authority_committed','replica_complete','purge_complete'))
              OR (c.relname='dispatch_journal' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','intent_id','dispatch_id','instance_id','sequence','owner_token','backend_epoch','credential_generation','operation','recovery','request_sha256','state','completion_sha256','created_xid'))
            WHEN privilege='INSERT' THEN c.relname IN ('backend_instances','dispatch_journal','dispatch_points')
            WHEN privilege='UPDATE' THEN c.relname='backend_instances'
              OR (c.relname='documents' AND a.attname='content_unavailable')
              OR (c.relname='document_owners' AND a.attname='backend_epoch')
              OR (c.relname='dispatch_journal' AND a.attname IN ('state','completion_sha256')) ELSE false END)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
          WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(caller_id,p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM
          (p.oid=function_id OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.scope_visible(text,text,text[],text[],text,boolean)')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.valid_identity_array(text[])')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.scope_grants()')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.writer_scope(text,text,text)')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.bound_stage(text,text,text,text,text)')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.supervisor_instance(text)')
           OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.lock_publication_owner(text,text,text,text,uuid,bigint,boolean)'))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard caller rejected' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;

    IF current_user<>'cragkit_qdrant_security_guard'
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=guard_id AND NOT
           (rolcanlogin OR rolsuper OR rolbypassrls OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolreplication OR rolinherit))
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=supervisor_role_id AND NOT
           (rolcanlogin OR rolsuper OR rolbypassrls OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolreplication OR rolinherit))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members WHERE member IN (guard_id,supervisor_role_id))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=supervisor_role_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE relowner=supervisor_role_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE proowner=supervisor_role_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE typowner=supervisor_role_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datdba=supervisor_role_id)
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=operator_id AND rolcreaterole AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m WHERE m.roleid=guard_id AND NOT
           (m.member=operator_id AND NOT m.inherit_option AND
             ((m.grantor=10 AND m.admin_option AND NOT m.set_option)
              OR (m.grantor=operator_id AND NOT m.admin_option AND m.set_option))))
       OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members WHERE roleid=guard_id)<>2
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE NOT r.rolsuper AND
           (pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid,supervisor_role_id,'MEMBER') OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid,'cragkit_qdrant_writer','MEMBER'))
           AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid,operator_id,'MEMBER'))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=guard_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r' AND c.relowner<>operator_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE relowner=guard_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE typowner=guard_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datdba=guard_id)
       OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE proowner=guard_id)<>1
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE oid=function_id AND proowner=guard_id AND prosecdef
           AND provolatile='v' AND proparallel='u' AND NOT proisstrict AND NOT proleakproof
           AND proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog','row_security=on']::text[])
       OR pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(guard_id,'cragkit_qdrant','CREATE')
       OR NOT pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(guard_id,'cragkit_qdrant','USAGE')
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r' AND c.relname<>'schema_migrations'
             AND NOT(c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
           WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND p.prosecdef AND p.oid NOT IN (function_id,pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.erase_purged_document(text,text,text,text,bigint,text,text,text,text,text,text,text,uuid,text,text,bigint,bytea,text,text,text)')))
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.erase_purged_document(text,text,text,text,bigint,text,text,text,text,text,text,text,uuid,text,text,bigint,bytea,text,text,text)') AND proowner='cragkit_qdrant_purger'::pg_catalog.regrole AND prosecdef AND provolatile='v' AND proparallel='u' AND NOT proisstrict AND NOT proleakproof AND proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog','row_security=on']::text[])
       OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy WHERE guard_id=ANY(polroles))<>7
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy WHERE guard_id=ANY(polroles) AND
          (polroles<>ARRAY[guard_id]::oid[] OR NOT polpermissive OR polqual IS NULL
           OR polname NOT IN ('security_guard_backend_select','security_guard_backend_update','security_guard_owner_select',
                             'security_guard_owner_update','security_guard_document_select','security_guard_document_update','security_guard_intent_select')
           OR polcmd NOT IN ('r','w') OR (polcmd='w' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard profile rejected' USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;

    -- Effective ACL checks include table grants, inherited grants and PUBLIC.
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
        CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE','REFERENCES','TRIGGER']) privilege
        WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(guard_id,c.oid,privilege))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
        CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','REFERENCES']) privilege
        WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND c.relkind='r' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
        AND pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(guard_id,c.oid,a.attnum,privilege) IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
          WHEN privilege='SELECT' THEN
            (c.relname='backend_instances' AND a.attname IN ('instance_id','backend_namespace','storage_identity','supervisor_id','epoch','state','recovery_id'))
            OR (c.relname='document_owners' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','instance_id','intent_id','owner_token','backend_epoch'))
            OR (c.relname='documents' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','active_generation_id','authorization_revision','mutation_epoch','principal_ids','grant_ids','language','kind','tag','tombstoned'))
            OR (c.relname='publication_intents' AND a.attname IN ('tenant_id','collection','document_id','intent_id','instance_id','action','payload_sha256','expected_mutation_epoch','authority_committed'))
          WHEN privilege='UPDATE' THEN (c.relname='backend_instances' AND a.attname='epoch')
            OR (c.relname='document_owners' AND a.attname='backend_epoch') OR (c.relname='documents' AND a.attname='mutation_epoch')
          ELSE false END)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
          WHERE n.nspname='cragkit_qdrant' AND pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(guard_id,p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM
            (p.oid=function_id OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.scope_visible(text,text,text[],text[],text,boolean)')
             OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.scope_grants()')
             OR p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('cragkit_qdrant.valid_identity_array(text[])')))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) a
          WHERE p.oid=function_id AND (a.grantee NOT IN (guard_id,supervisor_role_id) OR a.grantor<>guard_id
            OR a.privilege_type<>'EXECUTE' OR (a.grantee=supervisor_role_id AND a.is_grantable)))
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) a
          WHERE p.oid=function_id AND a.grantee=supervisor_role_id AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE' AND NOT a.is_grantable) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard ACL rejected' USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;

    IF pg_catalog.current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed'
       OR p_instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.backend_instance_id',true)
       OR p_owner_token IS NULL OR p_tombstoned IS NULL
       OR p_security_payload_sha256 IS NULL OR p_security_payload_sha256 !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
       OR p_backend_epoch IS NULL OR p_backend_epoch NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
       OR p_mutation_epoch IS NULL OR p_mutation_epoch NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid security guard input' USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;
    FOREACH identity_value IN ARRAY ARRAY[p_instance_id,p_backend_namespace,p_storage_identity,p_supervisor_id,
        p_recovery_id,p_tenant_id,p_document_id,p_owner_intent_id,p_security_intent_id,p_authorization_revision] LOOP
        IF identity_value IS NULL OR pg_catalog.octet_length(identity_value) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
           OR pg_catalog.btrim(identity_value,E' \t\r\n\f\013')='' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid security guard input' USING ERRCODE='22023';
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
    IF p_collection IS NULL OR pg_catalog.octet_length(p_collection) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128
       OR pg_catalog.btrim(p_collection,E' \t\r\n\f\013')=''
       OR (p_active_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND (pg_catalog.octet_length(p_active_generation_id) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
           OR pg_catalog.btrim(p_active_generation_id,E' \t\r\n\f\013')=''))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY[p_language,p_kind,p_tag]) value WHERE pg_catalog.octet_length(value)>1024) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid security guard input' USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;
    FOREACH identity_value IN ARRAY ARRAY['principal','grant'] LOOP
        acl_value:=CASE WHEN identity_value='principal' THEN p_principal_ids ELSE p_grant_ids END;
        IF acl_value IS NULL OR pg_catalog.cardinality(acl_value)>64
           OR (pg_catalog.cardinality(acl_value)>0 AND (pg_catalog.array_ndims(acl_value)<>1 OR pg_catalog.array_lower(acl_value,1)<>1))
           OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.unnest(acl_value) member WHERE member IS NULL
              OR pg_catalog.octet_length(member) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256 OR pg_catalog.btrim(member,E' \t\r\n\f\013')='')
           OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT pg_catalog.convert_to(member,'UTF8')) FROM pg_catalog.unnest(acl_value) member)<>pg_catalog.cardinality(acl_value)
           OR acl_value IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(member ORDER BY pg_catalog.convert_to(member,'UTF8'))
              FROM pg_catalog.unnest(acl_value) member),ARRAY[]::text[]) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid security guard input' USING ERRCODE='22023';
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    PERFORM instance_id FROM cragkit_qdrant.backend_instances WHERE instance_id=p_instance_id FOR SHARE;
    SELECT backend_namespace,storage_identity,supervisor_id,epoch,state,recovery_id INTO backend_row
      FROM cragkit_qdrant.backend_instances WHERE instance_id=p_instance_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(backend_row.backend_namespace,backend_row.storage_identity,backend_row.supervisor_id,
        backend_row.epoch,backend_row.state,backend_row.recovery_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(p_backend_namespace,p_storage_identity,p_supervisor_id,p_backend_epoch,'recovery_blocked'::text,p_recovery_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    PERFORM owner_token FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection
      AND document_id=p_document_id FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT instance_id,intent_id,owner_token,backend_epoch INTO owner_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners
      WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection AND document_id=p_document_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(owner_row.instance_id,owner_row.intent_id,owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(p_instance_id,p_owner_intent_id,p_owner_token,p_backend_epoch) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    PERFORM document_id FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection
      AND document_id=p_document_id FOR UPDATE;
    -- Reread after the document wait; never retain a pre-wait authority snapshot.
    SELECT backend_namespace,storage_identity,supervisor_id,epoch,state,recovery_id INTO backend_row
      FROM cragkit_qdrant.backend_instances WHERE instance_id=p_instance_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(backend_row.backend_namespace,backend_row.storage_identity,backend_row.supervisor_id,
        backend_row.epoch,backend_row.state,backend_row.recovery_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(p_backend_namespace,p_storage_identity,p_supervisor_id,p_backend_epoch,'recovery_blocked'::text,p_recovery_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT instance_id,intent_id,owner_token,backend_epoch INTO owner_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.document_owners
      WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection AND document_id=p_document_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(owner_row.instance_id,owner_row.intent_id,owner_row.owner_token,owner_row.backend_epoch)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(p_instance_id,p_owner_intent_id,p_owner_token,p_backend_epoch) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT active_generation_id,authorization_revision,mutation_epoch,principal_ids,grant_ids,language,kind,tag,tombstoned
      INTO document_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.documents WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection AND document_id=p_document_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(document_row.active_generation_id,document_row.authorization_revision,document_row.mutation_epoch,
       document_row.principal_ids,document_row.grant_ids,document_row.language,document_row.kind,document_row.tag,document_row.tombstoned)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(p_active_generation_id,p_authorization_revision,p_mutation_epoch,p_principal_ids,p_grant_ids,p_language,p_kind,p_tag,p_tombstoned) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cragkit_qdrant.publication_intents WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection
        AND document_id=p_document_id AND intent_id=p_owner_intent_id AND instance_id=p_instance_id
        AND (action='stage' OR (action IN ('update_authorization','tombstone') AND authority_committed))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT action,payload_sha256,expected_mutation_epoch,authority_committed INTO security_row FROM cragkit_qdrant.publication_intents
      WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND collection=p_collection AND document_id=p_document_id
        AND intent_id=p_security_intent_id AND instance_id=p_instance_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR security_row.action NOT IN ('update_authorization','tombstone')
       OR NOT security_row.authority_committed OR security_row.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p_security_payload_sha256
       OR security_row.expected_mutation_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM p_mutation_epoch-1
       OR (security_row.action='tombstone' AND NOT p_tombstoned) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'security guard mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.scope_visible(row_tenant text, row_collection text, row_principals text[], row_grants text[], row_authorization_revision text, row_tombstoned boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT NOT row_tombstoned
        AND row_tenant = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.tenant_id', true)
        AND row_collection = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.collection', true)
        AND row_authorization_revision = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.authorization_revision', true)
        AND octet_length(current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.principal_id', true)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND btrim(current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.principal_id', true), E' \t\r\n\f\013') <> ''
        AND cragkit_qdrant.scope_grants() IS NOT NULL
        AND (current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.principal_id', true) = ANY(row_principals)
            OR row_grants && cragkit_qdrant.scope_grants())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.supervisor_instance(row_instance text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

    SELECT current_setting('transaction_isolation') = 'read committed'
        AND row_instance = current_setting('cragkit_qdrant.backend_instance_id', true)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cragkit_qdrant.valid_identity_array(value text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT value IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(value) <= 64
        AND (cardinality(value) = 0 OR array_ndims(value) = 1)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM unnest(value) AS member
            WHERE member IS NULL OR octet_length(member) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
                OR btrim(member, E' \t\r\n\f\013') = ''
        )
